title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_bound_to_surrender_a_doms_of_genesis_novella_by_jenna_jacob_qisab (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_bound_to_surrender_a_doms_of_genesis_novella_by_jenna_jacob_qisab' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removal of the package alone is insufficient to guarantee the elimination of all malicious software introduced by its installation.
